significance: A Shiva temple at Acharapakkam revered in the 7th-century Tamil Saiva canon Tevaram, making it a Paadal Petra Sthalam. Imitation amphorae of the 6th-7th century found at the site and inscriptions recording Chola donations give it archaeological as well as devotional value.
story: A Pandya king is said to have followed a golden iguana that vanished beneath a tree; digging there revealed a linga, and the sage Trinedhrathari built two sanctums over it.
